title: Spanish-Style Falafel Crema Catalana
description: A keto-friendly twist on the traditional Spanish dessert, combining crispy falafel with creamy crema and a hint of elegance.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix crumbled falafel, elegant sugar substitute, and catalana orange zest.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together crema, keto-friendly sweetener, heavy cream, and vegan egg substitute.
4. Add catalana spices and sea salt to the crema mixture. Stir well.
5. Pour the crema mixture over the falafel mixture and mix until well combined.
6. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
8. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
9. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
10. Serve chilled, garnished with additional catalana orange zest if desired.
